title: Spend register line
description: One line of the spend register (lead agents design, "The spend register and the access matrix"): one paid service or recurring charge per record, at finance/spend/<id>.json (route finance/spend/[id]). The finance function owns it, and only the finance agent (role finance-agent) or a person writes it (writer function in packages/naive/src/records/data-model.json). Where each field is mastered is the access matrix: the source map's rules for spend-register (packages/naive/template/knowledge/sources.json), where the bank statement sync is the system of record for amount, currency and dates, finance owns status, and IT's tool record is the system of record for approval. The paying account is named by reference to a money record, never by a card or account number.

id.description: The line's id, the file name without .json

purpose.description: What the venture pays for, in a sentence

amount.description: The charge per cadence period, in currency. Mastered by the bank statement sync in the access matrix

cadence.description: How often it is charged; usage is metered

renewal_date.description: The next renewal or charge date, or null for a one-time charge

last_charged.description: The date of the last charge the bank statement shows

account.description: The paying account by reference: the id of a money record (money/<id>.json). Never a card or account number; an id must start with a letter, so a bare number is refused

function.description: The function that uses it: an id in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json

cluster.description: The capability cluster it belongs to, by id. The cluster catalog is lead agents build item 7, not built, so the id is not checked yet

connection.description: The connection record it pays for, by id. The connection record type is lead agents build item 7, not built, so the id is not checked yet

approval.description: The id of IT's tool record that approved the tool. IT's record is the system of record for approval in the access matrix; the register cites it and never copies it. IT tool records have no record type yet

status.description: Finance owns it. cancel-requested waits on a cancel-or-downgrade decision
